# Daily Dashboard V0.4.3

## New responsive clock widget

- One-column full-height mode displays a minimalist analog clock with a smoothly synchronized second hand.
- One-column half-height mode places today's calendar items beside the analog clock.
- Two-column mode switches to a condensed post-modern digital clock.
- Three-column mode adds today's connected calendar and reminders to the right of the digital clock.
- Change between system time and common IANA timezones directly inside the widget; the choice is saved immediately.

## Safer update recovery

- Settings can now locate and restore the immediately previous stable GitHub release.
- Rollback installers use the same repository allow-list and SHA-256 verification as forward updates.
- The existing NSIS post-install hook reopens Daily Dashboard after an update or rollback finishes.

## Verification

- Frontend production build and static/unit tests
- Rust backend tests
- Clock smoke tests at 1280×400, 1280×480, and 1920×720 across 75%, 100%, 150%, and 200% application scaling
- Windows x64 NSIS production build
